The season started on 10 March 2018{{cite web|url=http://bongdaplus.vn/v-league-2018-se-khai-mac-vao-ngay-10-3-2034351712.html|title=V.League 2018 sẽ khai mạc vào ngày 10/3 - Bongdaplus.vn|last=TUẤN |first=THÀNH}} and ran until 8 October 2018. It was expected to be known as the '''Toyota V.League 1''', however, in December 2017 [[Toyota]] ended their sponsorship deal with the [[Vietnam Football Federation]] one year early.{{cite web|url=https://tuoitrenews.vn/news/sports/20171224/toyota-stops-sponsoring-vietnams-topflight-football-league/43301.html|title= Toyota stops sponsoring Vietnam's top-flight football league|website=tuoitrenews.vn}} ==Changes from last season== ===Team changes=== The following teams have changed division since the 2017 season. {{col-begin|width=50em}} {{col-2}} ====To V.League 1==== '''Promoted from [[2017 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Nam Dinh FC]]{{cite web|url=http://www.vnleague.com/hang-nhat/bang-xep-hang/|title=BẢNG XẾP HẠNG MÙA GIẢI 2017|website=vnleague.com|access-date=2017-12-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222052928/http://www.vnleague.com/hang-nhat/bang-xep-hang/|archive-date=2017-12-22|url-status=dead}} {{col-2}} ====From V.League 1==== '''Relegated to [[2018 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Long An FC]] {{col-end}} ===Rule changes=== Due to the increased number of teams in [[2018 V.League 2]] (10), there will be 1.5 relegation places in the 2018 V.League 1 season - the team finishing 14th will be relegated automatically, whilst the team finishing 13th will play a two-legged play-off against the team that finishes second in the [[2018 V.League 2]]. The league will continue to operate the "2+1" foreigner rule, meaning each squad shall be allowed 2 non-Vietnamese players and 1 naturalised Vietnamese. [[Thanh Hóa FC|FLC Thanh Hoa]] and [[Song Lam Nghe An FC|Song Lam Nghe An]] shall be allowed 3 non-Vietnamese players, 1 naturalised Vietnamese and 1 player from [[Asia]] because they will participate in [[2018 AFC Cup|AFC Cup]]. ==Teams==
